normalized.title: Analytical Capacity on International Climate Change Mitigation and Tracking Progress of Action
normalized.description: In order to inform the EU’s own policies on climate change, as well as outreach to 3rd countries and international climate negotiations, the contracting authority requires access to state of the art analytical capacity, quantitative analysis and model-derived scenarios on global climate change mitigation action. This includes:— analysis of emissions reduction scenarios consistent with the Paris Agreement goals, assessment of action needed to reach them and comparison with current policies scenarios,— disaggregation of global climate action into major countries, economic sectors, emissions categories and greenhouse gases,— representation of developments in mitigation technologies,— provision to the contracting authority of new policy-relevant scenarios as required,— tracking of pledges and policies related to climate action and estimating their effects on emissions,— estimating the effects of climate action at subnational level and by non-state actors.

normalized.description: The Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation - SPRIND GmbH ("SPRIND") - aims to create new disruptive innovations from Germany. That means products, services and systems that make all our lives noticeably and sustainably better. To achieve this, SPRIND brings together new thinkers from science and business, people with outstanding ideas, special expertise, and passion. Hence, SPRIND provides an entrepreneurial environment that turns ideas into reality. The objective of BiconY Therapeutics GmbH, a SPRIND subsidiary, is the development of a bispecific antibody combination for the treatment of solid tumours. The combination consists of proprietary, bispecific CD3 anti-bodies (bsAbCD3) and bispecific CD28 co-stimulators (BiCos), which, when used together, significantly improve the specificity, sustainability, and efficiency of a T cell recruitment and thus the immune response against tumour cells. The aim of the research and development activities is to provide proof of concept for the effect of bispecific antibody therapy in the form of two phase I/IIa clinical trials. For the conduct of the planned phase I/IIa clinical trials, comprehensive central laboratory services are required for the collection logistics, processing, analysis, management, distribution and long-term storage of the biological specimens obtained from the trial participants. This includes in particular the analysis of cytokines in serum and the isolation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC). Therefore, BiconY is looking for a service provider to act as central laboratory for these clinical trials. Please refer to the tender documents for further details.
